prompt.project_info: Create a high-end lifestyle UGC portrait of an approved adult blonde woman lounging on a beige sectional in a modern apartment.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long tousled wavy blonde hair, blue eyes, soft makeup, natural light-tan skin texture, and a neutral engaging expression looking at camera. She wears an emerald-green satin two-piece set with a strapless bandeau top and high-waisted midi skirt with a twisted hip knot and high slit, plus layered gold chains and a simple bracelet. She lounges leaning back on her right hand with legs extended and left hand on her thigh.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 portrait, relaxed three-quarter/full seated framing on a textured beige fabric sectional, floor-to-ceiling mirrors reflecting wood cabinetry, kitchen, dining table, and black pendant lights. Keep the subject, emerald satin, sofa, and mirror depth as hierarchy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden-hour indoor ambient light with visible ceiling track lights, soft contact shadows, realistic satin highlights, and polished but natural influencer atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 8K photorealistic detail, 35mm lifestyle perspective, f/2.8, sharp eyes and fabric texture, natural depth, realistic skin and satin folds, subtle grain, 9:16 crop.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-end photorealistic 9:16 lifestyle portrait of an approved adult blonde woman with long tousled wavy hair, blue eyes, soft makeup, natural light-tan skin texture, and a neutral engaging expression looking directly at the camera. She lounges comfortably on a textured beige fabric sectional, leaning back on her right hand with legs extended and knees slightly bent, left hand resting on her thigh. She wears an emerald-green satin two-piece set with a strapless bandeau top and high-waisted midi skirt with a twisted knot at the hip and a high slit, plus layered gold chain necklaces and a simple bracelet. The modern upscale living room has floor-to-ceiling mirrors reflecting wood cabinetry, a kitchen, dining set, and black pendant lights, with warm ceiling track lighting. Use realistic satin highlights, soft contact shadows, natural skin and fabric texture, 35mm f/2.8 perspective, sharp focus, subtle grain, and warm golden-hour indoor ambience.
